summary: Markets are mixed and highly headline-sensitive: equities found relief as oil eased, while elevated yields and geopolitical risk continue to pressure technology and risk assets. Bitcoin was modestly higher near $82,300, gold strengthened toward $4,190, and Brent crude pulled back toward $103 after a sharp prior rise.[1][5] Crypto-specific analyst commentary available here is insufficient to verify fresh same-day altcoin calls, so new-token signals are limited.
